subject.title: Containerized/self-hosted deploys can't use externalized channel plugins: openKeyedStore is gated to trusted plugins, with no supported way to trust a self-hosted channel

question: Should OpenClaw support an immutable self-hosted official-plugin install root, or equivalent package-plus-install-record contract, so mounted state directories can use trusted official channel plugins without trusting arbitrary load paths?
rationale: The fix decides where trusted install provenance may live and which external channel packages receive host-managed persistent state access, so automation should not choose this security boundary or product shape.

options.title: Approve Immutable Provenance Path
options.body: Add a narrow official-install contract that preserves package identity, install record, resolved path, and official catalog checks outside the mounted state-dir conflict.

options.title: Document Unsupported For Now
options.body: Keep the fail-closed model and explicitly document that image-baked load-path official channel plugins cannot use trusted keyed state when their install record is hidden.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Plugin State Design
options.body: Defer this until the community keyed-state and official external-plugin trust model are designed together.

recommendation.title: Approve Immutable Provenance Path
recommendation.body: Add a narrow official-install contract that preserves package identity, install record, resolved path, and official catalog checks outside the mounted state-dir conflict.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned, already stated the intended fail-closed trust model on this issue, and have recent adjacent plugin trust-boundary history.
